newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO TURN AROUND LOSING STREAK AT SPORTING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO TURN AROUND LOSING STREAK AT SPORTING.

text.p: Struggling Spanish champions Atletico Madrid got back to winning ways by beating Sporting Gijon 1-0 thanks to a fine goal by Roberto Fresnedoso on Saturday.
After three successive defeats, the result came as a relief for Atletico, who face Borussia Dortmund in a crucial European Champions League game on Wednesday.
Another team that has not lived up to expectations this season, UEFA Cup side Espanyol, upset fourth-placed Real Betis 2-1 in a game in which both sides were reduced to 10 men.
Leaders Barcelona and second-placed Real Madrid were both playing later in the evening.
